div.head: II Cn 7.1
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe eard wylle rihtlice clænsian ⁊ unriht alecgan ⁊ rihtwisnesse lufian, þonne mot he georne þyllices styran ⁊ þyllic ascunian.
⁊ se ðe eard wylle rihtlice clænsian ⁊ unriht alecgan ⁊ rihtwisnysse lufian, ðonne mot he georne ðyllices steoran ⁊ ðyllic ascunian.
⁊ se ðe wille eard rihtlice clænsian ⁊ unriht á legan ⁊ rihtwysne lufian, þonne mot he georne ðillices styran ⁊ þillic ascunian.
[⁊, 1] And se ðe eard wille rihtlice clænsian ⁊ unriht alecgan ⁊ rihtwisnesse lufian, þonne mot he georne þillices styran ⁊ þillic ascunian . . . .
Et qui patriam iuste purgare desiderat et iniusticiam sternere ueramque diligere sapientiam, multo debet studio talia compescere et talia deuitare.
Et qui patriam recte emundare iniusticiamque deicere, iusticiam autem diligere uoluerit, illum oportet diligenter talia abhorrere et corrigere.
⁊ se ðe eard wylle rihtlice clænsian ⁊ unriht alecgan ⁊ rihtwisnysse lufian, ðonne mot he georne ðyllices steoran ⁊ ðyllic ascunian.
And se ðe eard wylle rihtlice clænsian and unriht alecgan and rihtwisnesse lufian, þonne mot he georne þyllices styran and þyllic ascunian.
Und wer das Land recht säubern will und Unrecht (immer A?) niederwerfen und Gerechtigkeit (den Gerechten A?) pflegen, dann muss er eifrig solchem steuern und solches vermeiden.
And whoever wishes to cleanse the land rightly and put down injustice (ever, A?) and love righteousness (the righteous, A?), then he must eagerly restrain such things and shun such things.
And he who desires to purify the land aright and to suppress injustice and cherish righteousness must zealously prohibit and avoid such crimes.
And he who wishes to purify the country rightly and to put down wrongdoing and to love righteousness, must then diligently restrain and shun such things.
And anyone who desires to properly purify the realm and eradicate injustice and embrace righteousness must diligently stamp out and condemn such crimes.
